comunidade.seo_titulo: Community: trips by people who are going | AquaTrip
comunidade.seo_desc: Trips created by AquaTrip members with open spots. Find someone heading to your destination and join them.
comunidade.titulo: Join people who are already going
comunidade.lead: Trips created by community members, with date, spots and price set by the organizer.
comunidade.vazio: There are no community trips yet.
comunidade.vazio_seguindo: People you follow haven't published trips yet.
comunidade.vazio_texto: Traveling soon? Publish your experience and open spots for others to join.
comunidade.como1: Say where you're going, when, how many spots you open and whether there's a price per person.
comunidade.como2: Interested people like, comment, follow and confirm their spot through AquaTrip.
comunidade.como3: Participants, comments and payments stay organized on your profile.

criar.lead: Traveling soon? Create the experience, set the spots and let others come along.
criar.moderada: This experience was taken down by moderation and can't be changed. Reason: {motivo}
criar.titulo_ph: E.g. Weekend at the Santos Aquarium
criar.desc_ph: What you'll do, the vibe of the trip, who it's for...
criar.desc_help: At least 30 characters. Don't add phone numbers or contacts: the conversation happens here.
criar.preco_help: The money goes straight to you through Mercado Pago.
criar.cobrar_html: Free experiences go live right away. To charge, the money must go straight to you: complete the partner sign-up and connect Mercado Pago.
criar.info_label: Meeting point, what to bring, transport
criar.info_ph: E.g. Meet at 9am at the aquarium entrance. Bring sunscreen and water.
criar.fotos_help: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each, at most {n}.
criar.fotos_moderacao: Photos are moderated before they appear. Until then we use an illustration of the category.
criar.pronto_texto: It already shows in the community. Follow likes, comments and participants on your profile.

social.nota_paga: Payment goes straight to {operador} through Mercado Pago. AquaTrip processes the booking and doesn't hold the money.
social.nota_gratuita: Free experience organized by a community member. Sort out the details in the comments.
social.comentar_ph: Ask something or say you're joining...
social.sem_comentarios: No comments yet. Be the first.
social.denunciar_texto: AquaTrip moderation reviews every report. The organizer doesn't know who reported.
social.motivo_golpe: Looks like a scam or misleading charge
social.motivo_contato_externo: Asks for contact or payment outside AquaTrip
social.gratuita_nota: Free: your spot is confirmed right away.
social.aviso_exemplo: Demo content: this trip and its profiles, comments and reviews were created to test the site and are not real.

perfil_social.foto_pendente: Photo under review: others will see it after approval.
perfil_social.bio_ph: E.g. Weekend diver, always chasing clear water.
perfil_social.sem_experiencias: You haven't published any experience yet.
perfil_social.sem_experiencias_txt: Create your first one and follow likes, comments and participants here.
perfil_social.sem_comentarios: No comments on your experiences yet.
perfil_social.publico_sem_exp: No published experiences at the moment.
perfil_social.perfil_exemplo: Demo profile created to test the site. Not a real person.

feedback.lead: File a complaint, send a suggestion or rate AquaTrip. The team replies right here.
feedback.mensagem_ph: Tell us what happened, with date and experience if relevant.
feedback.mensagem_help: Don't write passwords, card numbers or ID documents.
feedback.enviado: We received your entry. The reply will show here.

assistente.sub: Questions about the site, bookings and community
assistente.boas_vindas: Hi! I'm the AquaTrip assistant. I can explain how to book, create your own experience, payments, profile, privacy and more. How can I help?
assistente.sug1: How do I create an experience?
assistente.aviso: AI-generated answers. Don't send passwords, cards or documents.

client.cx_err_titulo: The title needs at least 6 characters.
client.cx_err_desc: Describe the experience in at least 30 characters.
client.cx_pausada: Experience paused. People already confirmed keep their spot.
client.sx_interesse_ok: Interest noted. The organizer will see it.
client.sx_denuncia_ok: Report sent. Moderation will review it.
client.pf_foto_pendente: Photo uploaded. Others will see it after moderation.
client.fb_assunto: The subject needs at least 4 characters.
client.fb_mensagem: Add a bit more detail (at least 10 characters).
